description_for_human: Manage your cap table — check ownership, issue equity, run dilution scenarios, review SAFEs and 409A valuations.
description_for_model: OpenCap Stack cap table management. Use this plugin to: list stakeholders and their equity ownership, issue equity grants, create and review SAFE notes, run dilution modeling, check 409A valuations, manage documents, and generate financial reports. Always confirm destructive actions with the user before executing.
